name: OMG public-site migration
description: Move only the four legacy indexed public pages; preserve application and installer routes.

rules.expression: (http.host eq "omg.latham.cloud" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path eq "/")

rules.description: OMG documentation index moved to getomg.dev
rules.expression: (http.host eq "omg.latham.cloud" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/docs" "/docs/"})

rules.description: OMG privacy page moved to getomg.dev
rules.expression: (http.host eq "omg.latham.cloud" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/privacy" "/privacy/"})

rules.description: OMG terms page moved to getomg.dev
rules.expression: (http.host eq "omg.latham.cloud" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/terms" "/terms/"})
